purpose: Preserve historical source bytes and enable source-based reasoning in canonical research hub. Documentation archive is not a proof of runtime capability.
archive_controls: Original Git blob SHA reused directly for each one of 71 Markdown/JSON files; no rendering or whitespace normalization.

Do not infer current API behavior from old version strings.
Controller task mapping is informational only; no automatic task completion or build authorization.
Manifest is a new audit artifact and is not one of the 71 original preserved source blobs.
